subject: Preflight: runbook & slot shift request for ClearBridge onboarding
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma.carter@clearbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding workshop — requested Nov 9 slot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough offer — wed like to lock in a two-hour workshop for our engineering and product teams. Proposed window: Nov 9, 10:00-12:00 PT. Goal is a combined console walkthrough (keys, RBAC, dashboard) + hands-on API enablement (token flows, quickstart).

High-level attendee list: myself (Director Eng), Anil R. (backend lead), Priya S. (security), 3 devs. We expect the session to be recorded.

Attached is a one-page desired agenda (desired_agenda.docx) and a short list of items wed like you to cover:
- Console: onboarding flow, team management, routing policies
- API: quickstart, request/response shapes, streaming basics
- Ops: runbook for incidents, where to find logs and cost dashboards

Can you confirm trainer(s) and whether you can do this as a single 2-hour block or recommend splitting? Also, any preflight items we should complete?

Thanks,
Emma Carter
Director of Engineering, ClearBridge Payments
emma.carter@clearbridge.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding workshop — requested Nov 9 slot

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the clear agenda. Were excited to run this. Quick notes after syncing with Ben and Marissa:

- Recommend splitting into two focused blocks to maximize hands-on time:
  * Day 1 (Console walkthrough) — 60-75 min: team setup, RBAC, routing, dashboards, Q&A
  * Day 2 (API enablement + labs) — 60-75 min: tokens, streaming, sample calls, short lab exercises

- If youd prefer a single 2-hour window we can do that, but some attendees usually miss the hands-on lab.

- Preflight asks (weve attached a preflight checklist):
  1) List of user emails for RBAC setup
  2) API key creation rights (or we can create scoped demo keys and hand off)
  3) A single test model you want to preview (or we can use rdl-mini for the lab)

Attachments: runbook_draft.md (our working runbook), preflight_checklist.pdf

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Nov 9 10:00-11:15 (Console) + Nov 10 10:00-11:15 (API)
- Option B: Nov 11 09:00-11:00 (single consolidated session)

Which option works better? Well block provisional calendar invites once you confirm and will send the final runbook in advance.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
---
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Emma Carter <emma.carter@clearbridge.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding workshop — requested Nov 9 slot

Hi Olga,

Appreciate the split suggestion — that actually sounds ideal. Unfortunately we just got a calendar override: company all-hands is scheduled Nov 9 at 10:30 and a few of our leads (Anil, Priya) cant make the morning window.

Can we do Option B on Nov 11 09:00-11:00 PT instead? Alternatively, if you can keep Console on Nov 9 but push to 13:00 PT that could work for some, but a single consolidated session on Nov 11 would be easiest for scheduling.

One more item: our security team needs a 20-30 minute block to cover VPN/network requirements and IAM provisioning before the API lab. Can that be added to the agenda or run as a short preflight call the day prior?

Attendees updated: Emma Carter (Director Eng), Anil Rao (Backend Lead), Priya Shah (Security), Devs: may join for API lab only.

Thanks — let us know which date you can confirm and well get attendees invited.

Emma
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding workshop — requested Nov 9 slot

Emma — thanks for the heads up. Nov 11 09:00-11:00 PT works for our team; Ive penciled it in and will send calendar invites after you confirm with your leads.

We can also run a 30-minute preflight call for Priya and the security team on Nov 10 at 10:00 PT to cover VPN/IAM and provisioning — can you confirm that slot? Preflight agenda will include:
- Required network/egress rules
- KMS/KMIP notes (if applicable)
- Steps for creating scoped API keys and token rotation policy

Action items:
- Emma: confirm Nov 11 09:00-11:00 PT for main session and Nov 10 10:00 PT for preflight (security)
- Olga: finalize runbook and send final_runbook_v1.pdf; create calendar invites and provisional demo keys
- Ben/Marissa: prepare lab credentials and short practice exercises

Attachments: final_runbook_v1.pdf (will send in follow-up email), preflight_checklist.pdf

If that all looks good Ill toggle the invites. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Phone: (650) 555-0199
